subject: Re: Saturday activity
text:
Thanks for following up. To move ahead, we should confirm the activity room by end of day. The sign-in sheet is not needed, but I will bring it anyway. Please share the attendance count by Thursday, or the organizer cannot reserve enough tables.

The activity begins at 10, not 9, as I mentioned earlier. I will send the checklist tomorrow so you have time to review it. This is the second day follow-up. If no changes arrive by 5, I will assume current plan stands. Please confirm.
